description:
PURPOSE: Exchanges the SMS code from start_phone_verification for a customer_grant (valid 60 minutes) that gives access to this customer's own bookings.
WHEN TO USE: Right after the customer types the code from start_phone_verification.
WHEN NOT TO USE: Not for the booking code from prepare_booking (that one goes to create_booking).
REQUIRED: verification_id, code. SIDE EFFECTS: none besides issuing the grant. Pass customer_grant to get_my_bookings, check_availability(booking_reference), reschedule_booking and cancel_booking.

code.description: 6-digit code the customer received by SMS

session_id.description: Optional. session_id from the previous result, if you have it. The server also recovers the session from quote_id / slot_id / confirmation_id / customer_grant.

name: verify_phone_code

error.description: Stable machine-readable error id when success=false, e.g. missing_required_fields, unsupported_postcode, no_availability

success.description: true = operation done / data returned; false = see error

title: Potwierdź kod
